name: admin_invite_requests_list
description: List all pending workspace invite requests. (GET /admin.inviteRequests.list)

team_id.description: ID for the workspace where the invite requests were made.

cursor.description: Value of the `next_cursor` field sent as part of the previous API response

limit.description: The number of results that will be returned by the API on each invocation. Must be between 1 - 1000, both inclusive
